description: Asks, on a writable copy, which unbracketed words CREATE TABLE refuses as a table name through Database.Execute (dbFailOnError): each statement is CREATE TABLE <word> (A LONG) for the same words as ddl-reserved-column-names, with no DBEngine.Errors read between them. At the end the TableDefs names are listed, so that refused words are the missing tables. Fixture r-def-expr-sql-main is opened on a writable fresh copy through DAO.DBEngine.120; engine version and the loaded modules (once) are recorded; each recordset reads Name, Type and Value of every field.
retentionNote: Designed r-def-expr-sql probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
